notes: New System card on the OG panel: your microphone level and mute, Bluetooth and Wi-Fi on/off, and which Windows power plan is running - all in one card.

Every row is drawn only if this machine actually has it. A desktop with no microphone and no radios never sees the card at all, and a laptop with one power scheme gets no plan row, because one option is not a choice.
Pressing a radio or a power plan dims it until Windows confirms the change, rather than flipping it immediately. The panel never shows a state the machine has not agreed to yet.
The card reads the same background process the volume and brightness card already uses, so adding it starts nothing new.

Fixed while testing: the panel read the list of power plans and which one was running as a single cached answer, so after you switched plans it painted the old one back and then would not let you correct it. Which plan is running is now…
